_description: Configuration parameters for OPGEE attribute calculations

time_scope.description: Process 2025 data only (12 months) for initial testing

functional_unit_classification.description: GOR threshold for oil vs gas field classification when field produces BOTH oil and gas

logic.description: Three-way classification logic based on which production files contain the field

rules.condition: Field only in oil production file (produccin-de-petrleo-por-yacimiento.csv)
rules.note: No gas production or negligible gas

rules.condition: Field only in gas production file (produccin-de-gas-por-yacimiento.csv)
rules.note: No oil production (pure gas field or condensate)

rules.condition: Field in BOTH files (has both oil and gas production)
rules.note: Use threshold to determine which is dominant

implementation_pseudocode: # After merging oil and gas production files with outer join:

gor_calculation.description: Gas-to-Oil Ratio: volume of gas produced per volume of oil
gor_calculation.units_input: gas in m³, oil in m³
gor_calculation.units_output: m³ gas per m³ oil (dimensionless ratio)

source_files.gas_prod: produccin-de-gas-por-yacimiento.csv (sum of all gas pressure categories, converted from Mm³ to m³)
source_files.oil_prod: produccin-de-petrleo-por-yacimiento.csv (sum of all production types: primary + secondary + assisted)

gor_calculation.note: Outer join ensures we capture fields that only produce oil OR only produce gas

eor_detection.description: WIR > 5 suggests steam flooding (high water injection)

api_gravity.source: Calculated from 'Densidad Media (Ton/m3)' in oil production file
api_gravity.note: API gravity is NOT static - oil density can change over field lifetime
api_gravity.handling_missing: If density is 0 or null, API will be null (only applies to gas-only fields)

attribute_temporality.description: Classification of attributes by how they vary over time

pseudo_static.description: May vary slightly but treated as constant for aggregation
pseudo_static.note: Depth can vary across wells in a field but average is relatively stable

time_varying_field_level.description: Available in field production data, varies month-to-month
time_varying_field_level.source: Field production files (already aggregated by government)
time_varying_field_level.aggregation: Use directly from field-month records (no additional aggregation needed)

time_varying_well_level.description: Aggregated from well-level data, varies month-to-month
time_varying_well_level.aggregation: Group by (field_id, year, month) and count/aggregate

oil_gas_merge.description: Merge oil and gas production files to get complete picture
oil_gas_merge.rationale: Outer join captures fields that only produce oil OR only produce gas

expected_results.mixed_fields: both not null → calculate GOR for classification

validation_rules.description: Sanity check ranges for validated data quality
